name: jackok-mods
description: Claude Code mods: a session state band, a task pane with subagents and loaded instruction files, and handoff cards for work left to a later session

plugins.name: state
plugins.description: Session state band above the prompt: context trend, model and effort, git, rate limits, cost, tool and subagent tallies, threshold toasts; /state hides or shows it

plugins.name: manage-pane
plugins.description: Task tools (task_create, task_update, task_list) and a pane with the session's tasks, the subagents working them, and the loaded instruction files with load counts; /pane opens or closes it

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Handoff cards for work left to a later session, kept as markdown files in the repo's handoff/ folder: card and list tools, and a band of cards above the prompt; /handoff hides or shows it
